parameters.doc: Diff reference the change is measured from, for example origin/main.
parameters.name: base

parameters.doc: Change kind, for example refactor, integration, or docs.
parameters.name: kind

parameters.doc: Lenses that must succeed. Fewer fails the lens group, which stops the council for the chair to substitute a lens or decide. 0 takes the review ladder minimum for risk_tier, at least 1.
parameters.name: min_reviews

parameters.doc: Review depth override from routing review shapes (quick, standard, deep).
parameters.name: review_shape

parameters.doc: Tags that trigger conditional lenses: security, concurrency, terminal.
parameters.name: risk_tags

parameters.doc: Risk tier that selects the review shape.
parameters.name: risk_tier

parameters.doc: Review size override: small, medium, or large.
parameters.name: size

parameters.doc: Issue number or file the change answers.
parameters.name: spec

parameters.doc: Immutable review subject: a commit, a node or the integration head.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.doc: Route for the verifier. Define a route named verifier in another model family; without one the senior route is used and the substitution is recorded.
parameters.name: verifier_tier

parameters.doc: Verifier stages between the lenses and the synthesis, preferably from another model family; 0 skips verification.
parameters.name: verifiers

citations: Claude Code review and Bugbot vendor reports (vendor-reported)
pattern.cost: 1 framing attempt + one attempt per selected lens + verifiers + 1 synthesis
pattern.select_when: A change needs review before it lands; depth follows the routing review shape.
pattern.summary: Independent lenses review one immutable subject; a verifier, preferably from another model family through configured routing, tries to falsify the findings; a senior synthesis reconciles them with a disposition per finding.
